The .SRCINFO and .install files were correctly identified as safe by both models. The qwen model's inconclusive result was due to an API error (HTTP 400), not a security concern. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by the qwen model experiencing an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully completed the PKGBUILD review and found it safe. This is a tool failure, not a genuine security disagreement.
coverage_issues: Both models incorrectly skipped '0001-fix-input-capture-for-deskflow-on-wayland.patch' by misidentifying it as a binary file. Patch files are text files and are applied during the build process (typically in prepare()), so they must be reviewed for potential malicious code injection.
The qwen model failed to complete the PKGBUILD audit due to an API error, leaving the most critical file unreviewed in that report.
false_negatives: The patch file '0001-fix-input-capture-for-deskflow-on-wayland.patch' was not reviewed by either model. While the filename suggests a legitimate bug fix, patches can contain arbitrary code modifications and should be audited to ensure no malicious changes are introduced during the build process.
re_audit_focus: 0001-fix-input-capture-for-deskflow-on-wayland.patch - must be reviewed as a text file to verify it contains only legitimate bug fixes and no malicious code injection
learnings: File type detection is incorrectly classifying .patch files as binary. The audit tool should recognize common text-based file extensions (.patch, .diff, .txt, .md, etc.) and ensure they are sent to the model for review.

API errors should be handled gracefully - when a model fails to review a critical file like PKGBUILD, the tool should either retry or clearly flag this as a tool failure rather than marking the package as inconclusive.
Patch files should be prioritized for review since they are applied during the build process and could contain malicious modifications to the source code.
